Straight talk: no 3-day trips are on the schedule in January yet in my 120-day window — the only 3-days I'm seeing are mid-December (Intrepid 12/14 & 12/17, and Electra 12/10). January 3-days typically open up closer to the date, so check back in a few weeks or watch the [Trip Planner](#tripplanner).

That said, for an experienced angler targeting **January bluefin on a 3-day**, here's the honest historical read:

- **[Pacific Queen](#boat/Pacific%20Queen)** (Fisherman's Landing) — 2.28 TPA/day across 72 trips. Consistent producer, strong crew on bluefin knife-jig and flat-fall programs. This is the one I'd watch for a January 3-day drop.
- **[Pacific Voyager](#boat/Pacific%20Voyager)** (Seaforth) — 2.14 TPA/day over 80 trips. Big-fish reputation and a captain who'll grind for quality over quantity — ideal for an experienced stick.
- **[Polaris Supreme](#boat/Polaris%20Supreme)** (Seaforth) — 2.07 TPA/day, 62 trips. More typically a 5+ day boat but occasionally runs 3-days; elite bluefin pedigree when she does.
- **[Pegasus](#boat/Pegasus)** (Fisherman's Landing) — 2.37 TPA/day over 64 trips. Quietly one of the better bluefin numbers on the board.

**My pick to watch:** Pacific Queen or Pacific Voyager — both have the right gear program and crew depth for January cows. January bluefin on a 3-day usually means fewer bites but bigger grade (100–250#+ class), so boat culture matters more than win rate.

One option worth considering: a mid-December **[Intrepid 3-Day (12/17)](https://pointloma.fishingreservations.net/sales/user.php?trip_id=1059495)** is still open with 18/26 spots — not January, but same water, same fish class.
